# Use semantic HTML labels and one container for conditional key details

In the HTML expiry dialog, bind the select to a real label. Use HTML layout, such as a CSS grid, for key properties instead of XUL boxes. Wrap optional details in one container and toggle it as a unit. Check simple and complex mode after layout changes. In this dialog, showing details initially then hiding for simple mode was accepted because adding them dynamically could push OK/Cancel beyond the initial window size. Do not turn hidden-by-default into a universal rule.

Scope: OpenPGP HTML UI.

Paths:

- `mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/changeExpiryDlg.xhtml`
- `mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/changeExpiryDlg.js`
